atlas_binding: Existing key_scene images verified against manifest hashes; H2 approval remains pending.

organization.note: N01–N09 are design units, not replacement runtime scene IDs.

style_bible.premise: 规模失控却仍工作的夜班物流系统：笨重外壳、小轮大箱、粗切面和歪斜夹具贯穿九区。
style_bible.shape: 功能清楚的服务沟槽与夸张机械外形共存；形体笑点集中成组，避免每个小件争抢视线。
style_bible.palette: 灰黄、褪色灰绿和暗橡胶；普通黄色压低对比，金色主动离轨装置保持优先级。

baseline_facts.evidence_boundary: main/fast native; safe/rescue/high/high-short headless. Recorded coverage is not every input/continuous sweep.

supported_motion.center_lateral_bound: width_at(s) for single_lane; width_at(s)-1.35 m otherwise
supported_motion.protected_body: Union of train OBB at every supported center, including intermediate lane changes.
supported_motion.conservative_outer_guard: Train center to full width_at(s), then Minkowski sum with train OBB.
supported_motion.local_up_rule: Use actual rotated SupportFrame for wall/inverted/loop; never WORLD_UP substitution.

camera.status: camera traces exist; new-art and alternate-view tests pending

airborne.status: all 16 logical connections retained; no continuous all-input swept-volume proof

functional.hard_obstacle: 3 m width × (height-bottom) × 2 m depth; centered at lane*4.4, bottom+(height-bottom)/2
functional.soft_obstacle: 1.3 m width/depth; actual height from obstacle; retain original soft_props state binding
functional.advance_warning: 3.5×0.08×3.8 m, local y=0.18; original four preview ratios 1/.72/.48/.28

protected_contract.water_and_floors: Per-region/local support frame. Any proposed surface must subtract all protected volumes; no global flat ground/water.

functional_translation.Bed/Rail/Clamps: 模块化服务沟槽、粗扣件和笨重支架；实际行车面连续，几何比例遵守冻结轨道。
functional_translation.ApproachMarks: 低矮宽框白叉警示垫；不能变成加速箭头或看似硬障碍的高墩。
functional_translation.Block/LowBeam: 锁死货箱/载货台车、厚壳检修横梁；按真实障碍包络区分可通过空隙。
functional_translation.SoftProp: 松散包裹、锥桶和薄壁周转箱；原碰撞事件使其倾倒/恢复。
functional_translation.Pickets/NearSpeedMarkers: 偏轴扫描小灯、歪脖大灯头；路外身体可夸张，小青色镜片保持导向语义。
functional_translation.NoEntrySign: 笨重肘形支架上的白横杠禁入牌；避免普通装饰牌复制相同信号。
functional_translation.ReleaseWindow/InvertedEjectPad: 金色弹簧/夹具解锁机座；仅装饰演出，不新增机关判定。
functional_translation.CatchRunway/CatchGate: 青色扫描导向与贯通接收框；看起来笨但入口净空清楚。
functional_translation.Rescue: 紫色退件回收线和应急扫描灯；不与普通货物流向混淆。

water_design.rule: Warehouse floors remain local stepped assemblies, not a global ground plane.

underpass_ceiling_constraint.meaning: About1m at the common center axis only; upper track is banked. This does not establish a uniform slab thickness or clearance across the full crossing.

design_proposal.bridge_rule: Art bridge wraps the existing cliff_turn crossing; underpass remains the same 19 m-lower corridor.
design_proposal.bridge_mass_rule: Keep bulky trusses/box girders beside or above the upper deck; no deep downstand beam in the existing lower opening. Resolve local bank/width/underpass roof geometry before choosing slab thickness.
design_proposal.tower_center_offset_rule: 34 m along flattened cliff_turn local right, 39 m world-up from the measured bridge anchor
design_proposal.clearance_status: not_tested; bounds are proposals, not approved safe volumes
design_proposal.cross_view_rule: One transform/geometry hypothesis for N07/N08/N09; do not duplicate or move the tower to force it into a shot. A forward launch camera may leave it behind/out of frame; visibility is unresolved.

instance_interface.frame: metres,+Y up,-Z forward; source normalization once; instance transforms separate
instance_interface.soft_prop_rule: Preserve original obstacle key / upright transform / hit and restore binding.
instance_interface.batch_rule: Read original Pickets/ApproachMarks/etc batch transforms; old visual_slots is not exhaustive.

scope: Design draft only. No native run, Blender build, paid generation or asset production authorization.
